# Simditor compatibility dependencies

These three MIT-licensed packages preserve the exact versions used by the Vue 2 baseline (simple-hotkeys 0.2.1, simple-module 2.1.0, simple-uploader 2.1.0). Their original Git-only releases are not published on npm. They are vendored to keep keyboard and upload behavior reproducible without enabling Git dependency downloads. Original licenses and source are retained; only package metadata/local dependency paths are adjusted.
